envelope.description: Design-review single-chunk adapters and runReview / runTemplateReview

body.title: Design-review single-chunk adapters and runReview / runTemplateReview
body.summary: Premise adapter: extract (fail-review), probe (deterministic, runStage), and verify per premise (record-not-judged, the 3-minute timeoutMs, repo cwd as an addition). The controller plan uses today's single batched verify. Template adapter: one reviewer-session stage whose validate is today's checklist check, re-issued once by the pipeline with today's correction text, under job.deadlineAt. runReview and runTemplateReview switch to the pipeline; verifyOrRecord's own retry and the template re-ask leave the path.
acceptanceChecks: An under-limit DEF review makes one extract call, a probe and one verify call per premise with the 3-minute limit; extraction failing fails the review; a verify call failing twice records the premise as not judged.
An under-limit HLD review makes one reviewer-session call and gives today's report; a checklist break is re-issued once by the pipeline.
The controller premise plan under the limit offers one batched verify call.
